skill_name: List some of the advantages of using a pre-trained language model.
workflow: Some of the advantages of using a pre-trained language model include the ability to leverage existing training data which results in faster and more cost effective development, the ability to generate state-of-the-art results for a wide range of tasks, the ability to get more accurate results for rare word types, and the ability to fine-tune models for specific tasks such as speech recognition.
